ownerDirective.interpretation: The finite Westlight staff rail-inspection transfer is delegated to the implementation team; hard safety is not waived.

hardSafetyKernel.rule: Exact state/inverse, side-lane/rail retention, and independent QA are mandatory.
Fresh immutable source and exact preflight immediately precede mutation.
Forward and reverse parser validation is strict-noop.
Exact block-entity and fresh live-entity clearance are mandatory.
Execution is journaled; failure invokes exact reverse rollback.
Fresh post capture, rollback poststate proof, and independent QA precede acceptance.

operationalControls.scopeLocalFailureRule: Failure blocks only this exact Westlight inspection transfer.
